elements.body: **+ Add Event:** click the **+** at the bottom of the table below to submit a new event / sponsorship request (name, type, date, requester, budget, justification). Finance and Brand Council pick it up from there.
Set performance targets before Brand Council review
**Alert:** the events below have no targets yet. Add a row in the table underneath -- type the **Event Name** exactly as it appears above, then the target metrics and the Finance-approved budget.
Review targets & budget, then record a decision
Add a row below -- type the **Event Name** exactly as it appears above, then set **Decision** (Approved/Denied), **Reviewer**, and **Comments**.
Targets vs. actuals for a single event
**Enter Actuals** (after the event runs): add a row below -- type the **Event Name** exactly as it appears in the picker above, then the actual results and spend.
Aggregate performance across all events this year
